# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Arts, Entertainment, and Recreation | Sole Proprietorship

**Regulation to analyze:** PCI DSS v4.0.1, PCI Security Standards Council standard (contractual, not law)
**Why:** Cris Santos Company operates a live event venue with ticketing here, so card payments are its most binding security obligation (PCI DSS is a contractual standard enforced through card brands, not law). Research note: the sector research chose Nevada Gaming Commission Regulation 5.260, which applies only to licensed gaming operators; use it instead if the venue includes a casino.
